title: Oil Rubbed Bronze 6 Position Multi Hook Tie & Belt Rack - 15.5-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass, Mercury Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Finished in Oil Rubbed Bronze, clear the countertop and keep robes, towels, and accessories organized in one place—backed by a limited lifetime warranty, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any bathroom.

  • Oil Rubbed Bronze brings rich depth and character
  • Coordinates with other Mercury pieces for a distinguished, heritage-inspired look
  • Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Holds up to daily use—solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives
  • Designed to coordinate as part of the Mercury collection—complete your bathroom with matching pieces

Specs

  • Product type: 6 position multi hook / tie and belt rack
  • Mounting: Wall mount (concealed screw mounting)
  • Material: Brass
  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 15.5 in x 3.2 in x 4 in
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Product weight: 3 lb
  • Included: Multi hook and all installation hardware
  • Screw size: #8 X1 1/4"
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
meta_description: Organize robes, towels, ties & belts with a 15.5-inch wall-mount multi hook. Solid brass, concealed screws, 6 positions, lifetime warranty.
